app: FlatDesk: Zendesk alternative with AI included at a flat price (built on Chatwoot)

personas.role: Tier-1 support agent at a 7-agent Shopify brand
personas.cares_about: Closing tickets fast with good CSAT so the queue never runs away; hitting first-response SLA.
personas.time_spent: Most of the day in the inbox: reading tickets, looking up orders in Shopify, typing the same 'where is my order' answers.
personas.struggles: Switching between the helpdesk and Shopify admin for every order question; repetitive answers; AI drafts that don't know the order.
personas.how_helps: AI-drafted reply already filled with the live order and tracking, customer context in the right bar, one-click send.

tasks.name: Open a ticket that needs a human

personas.cares_about: SLA compliance, balanced workload, coaching agents.
personas.time_spent: Watching the queue, reassigning tickets, chasing breaches, weekly 1:1s.
personas.struggles: No single view of tickets about to breach; finds out after the fact.
personas.how_helps: An 'SLA at risk' view with timers and one-click reassignment; workload by agent in Reports.

tasks.name: See tickets about to breach SLA

personas.cares_about: CSAT, cost per ticket, headcount plan, what share the AI resolves.
personas.time_spent: Reports, vendor reviews, planning peak season staffing.
personas.struggles: Zendesk AI billed per resolution makes cost unpredictable; can't show the board savings.
personas.how_helps: Reports show AI resolution rate, cost per ticket and CSAT on one screen, plus the savings vs the old Zendesk bill.

tasks.name: Read AI resolution rate, cost per ticket and CSAT

personas.cares_about: Predictable software spend; no surprise invoices; renewal terms.
personas.time_spent: Month-end close, approving vendor bills, budget vs actual.
personas.struggles: Per-resolution AI fees and seat hikes make the helpdesk bill swing month to month.
personas.how_helps: Flat bill visible at all times, with a side-by-side of what the Zendesk plan would have cost this month.

tasks.name: See this month's bill and the comparison

personas.cares_about: Revenue, repeat purchases, not losing sales to slow replies, and not wasting a week on a migration.
personas.time_spent: Everywhere; checks support when something breaks.
personas.struggles: Fear that switching helpdesks will lose ticket history and break things in peak season.
personas.how_helps: Migration tab shows exactly what has moved, what's left and the go-live date, with the 7-day guarantee.

tasks.name: Check migration progress and go-live date

personas.cares_about: SSO, access control, data ownership, being able to leave.
personas.time_spent: User provisioning, security reviews, vendor questionnaires.
personas.struggles: Lock-in and unclear data location; exporting data from Zendesk is painful.
personas.how_helps: Admin shows SSO status, data region, full export and that the software is open source (MIT core).

tasks.name: Find SSO, data region and export

personas.role: Ops manager serving Spanish-speaking customers on WhatsApp
personas.cares_about: Answering customers in their channel and language; fewer missed messages.
personas.time_spent: Juggling a separate WhatsApp phone and the helpdesk.
personas.struggles: WhatsApp lives outside the helpdesk; translations are manual.
personas.how_helps: WhatsApp is a channel in the same inbox and the AI drafts in the customer's language.

tasks.name: Open the WhatsApp channel and a Spanish conversation

personas.cares_about: Deflection: more questions answered by the AI and articles.
personas.time_spent: Writing and updating articles; reviewing what customers ask.
personas.struggles: Doesn't know which questions the AI fails on.
personas.how_helps: AI agent tab lists the questions the AI handed to humans, with a one-click 'draft article'.

tasks.name: See AI knowledge gaps and draft an article
